# Demo: Car Workshop (Warsztat Samochodowy)

> A demo website for a car workshop / mechanic, built by freelance web developer
> Konrad Malinowski as part of his portfolio. Angular 21 with Signals and Tailwind
> CSS - it shows prospective clients what their own workshop website could look like.

The site content is in Polish. All business data - the "APEX Mechanik" name,
address, phone number, reviews and ratings - is fictional placeholder content
for demonstration purposes, not a real, operating business. The client zone,
repair history, and cost calculator are simulated client-side with no backend;
nothing submitted through any form (booking, contact, calculator) is sent
anywhere or stored.

## Features

- Client zone with full vehicle repair history
- Step-by-step service cost calculator
- Multi-step appointment booking: service → date → confirmation
- Diagnostics section with detailed fault descriptions and error codes
- Next service inspection added automatically to the client's calendar
- Fully responsive, mobile-first

## Pages

- [Home](https://konradxmalinowski.github.io/demo-mechanik/): overview, services grid, process, FAQ
- [Services](https://konradxmalinowski.github.io/demo-mechanik/uslugi): full service catalogue with approximate time/cost
- [Booking](https://konradxmalinowski.github.io/demo-mechanik/rezerwacja): 6-step appointment booking flow
- [Client zone](https://konradxmalinowski.github.io/demo-mechanik/strefa-klienta): mock vehicle dashboard - visit history, repair history, service recommendations, documents
- [Cost calculator](https://konradxmalinowski.github.io/demo-mechanik/kalkulator): category + option based repair cost estimator
- [Contact](https://konradxmalinowski.github.io/demo-mechanik/kontakt): contact details and demo contact form

## Tech

- Angular 21, TypeScript, Angular Signals
- Tailwind CSS (utility-first styling)
- Server-side rendered / prerendered at build time (all 6 routes above are
  static HTML with the full content already in the initial response - no
  client-side JavaScript execution required to read any page)
- Angular CLI build tooling
